300c (Q7040898), actic (Q1030229), u-r (Q7041070), laurel-c130-ev (Q25110255), santana (Q1993807), verita (Q1993838): Wikidata gives no usable description; not verified whether they are production cars.
Atleon line in model-lines-auto starts 1980 (L/M-series); the Atleon name was used 2000–2013 (ECO-T marketed as Atleon 1997–2000) per en.wikipedia oldid 1259712321.
Nissan Cherry (European name of Pulsar N10/N12, 1980s) is missing from models-auto and lines; not checked against a source in this sweep because of Wikipedia rate limits.
almera-tino photo shows the Japanese Nissan Tino (same V10 car); a European Almera Tino photo would be better.
Pathfinder, Patrol, Pulsar, Sunny, Skyline, Serena, Vanette, Tiida, Bluebird, Maxima, Prairie, 200 SX, Silvia remain single family cards; splitting them into generations was not done.
summary: Nissan card file had most generation years/status empty; filled years, status as of 2026-10, facelifts and codes for 40+ lines from fixed en.wikipedia revisions, split Navara (D40/D23/D27), Murano (Z50–Z53), Note (E11/E12/E13), Almera (N15/N16), Primastar and Interstar into generations, and fixed Micra K11 end (2002→2003) and K13 (ended 2022 → still built in Mexico). Make entry (Japan, founded 1933) checked, no change.
